paragraphs.source_en: The master continued, “Dying is painful, but being unable to die is still more painful. For people with nervous prostration, living is a greater pain than death, and so they are forever fretting over death. They do not fret because they fear dying; they are considering what manner of dying would be best. Ordinary people, however, are not clever enough; they leave matters to nature and neglect them, and in the end society torments them to death. But there is a special sort of person who is not content to be tormented to death piecemeal by society in that fashion.
